## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Migration 3 must back up current user data before merge because dropping the column can permanently lose legacy email values.

## Changes
The pull request adds migrations dropping `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`, with a backup for orders. It adds a test covering both removals and preservation of coupon codes.

## Critical
- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping legacy_email — For users inserted or whose legacy email changed after migration 2, this drop destroys values absent from the earlier backup. Your migration omits the `backup_table` call used by the other destructive migrations. — After the migration commits, operators cannot recover those legacy email values from the migration backups.
